github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Write the commit subject and body in Korean. (Exceptions: Conventional Commit type, scope, technology names)
Allowed pairs: ✨ feat, 🐛 fix, 📝 docs, ♻️ refactor, ✅ test, 🔧 chore, 🎨 style, ⚡ perf, 👷 ci, 📦 build
Priority: Use 'feat' for new features/flows/APIs/tasks. Use 'fix' for bug fixes and exceptions. Use 'refactor' ONLY for internal cleanups with absolutely no behavior changes.
Subject: Short and specific, focusing on the single most important change.
Body: Omit body for simple changes. If necessary, use short bullets with headers: '**변경 이유**', '**주요 변경 사항**', '**영향 범위**'.
